verdicts.reason: A turns the layout into a clean two-column banner: the can sits centered in a full circle with the logo grouped under it. But the quote is squeezed into a narrow 4-line column with a weak 'a' line-end, the attribution is jammed right under the quote, there is a large dead gap below the quote mark, and the circle crowds the top edge. B gets the quote line length right (3 lines), but the purple circle is pushed off to the bottom-right, so the can's top half floats on the plain background and only its bottom overlaps the circle edge. That misregistration looks accidental, and the logo straddles the circle edge, which weakens the original's deliberate product-in-circle motif.
